question: Can separate evidence dimensions, score contributions and historical changes be monitored without collapsing missing data into stage claims?
universe: full SW2021 catalogue, levels ranked separately
price: R18 frozen snapshot and F score components only; no model probability
expectation: R15 complete-report barrier FY+1; latest snapshot not later than asof, age displayed, exact-day versus older snapshot distinguished, no forward filling into usable score
valuation: exact-day PE percentile and its coverage displayed as historical proxy; no loss-company imputation
crowding: exact-day turnover percentile is trading proxy only, holdings missing so dual crowding unknown
mechanism: R20 exact date and clock selected-company facts; no whole-sector inference
stage: six economic stages not established by these inputs; dimensions may coexist, no probability normalization
changes: same identity, same clock; rank changes separately from coverage changes, new facts separated from economic activity dates
invalidation: missing price, lost price readiness, stale/missing expectations, source coverage, missing holdings and unsupported economic-stage labels explicit
validation: full catalogue, no future evidence, score contribution conservation, clock-isolated changes, unknowns preserved; no outcome evaluation or threshold search
